description: Vera's campaign vocabulary. Replaces the engine default (the FSC-era fighter/multi-fighter/event/rivalry/brand) so the Campaign Builder speaks clinic, not fight promotion. 'subjects' is the cardinality of the subject binding and drives both validation and the subject picker: none | one | two | many | event. Vera's subject axis is its services (client.json topicLabel = Service).

types.label: brand
types.description: No specific service. The whole pillar mix is in play, weighted as configured. This is the shape of the 12-post POC campaign.

types.label: service
types.description: One service, followed through education, experience and results. The consultation-led arc for a single treatment.
types.hint: Pick exactly one. POM-sensitive services stay consultation-led and unnamed in copy.

types.label: multi-service
types.description: Several services together: the menu, a pathway, or how treatments combine over a course.

types.label: seasonal
types.description: Timing-led rather than service-led: skin-health season, party-season prep, a new-year reset. The hook is timeliness, never price or urgency.
